en.p: There are a hyperbola $C$ with two foci $\mathrm{F}(c,\,0)$, $\mathrm{F'}(-c,\,0)\ (c>0)$ and a point A on the $y$-axis. Let P be the point where hyperbola $C$ meets segment AF, and P' the point where it meets segment AF'. When line AF is parallel to one of the asymptotes of hyperbola $C$ and
what is the length of the transverse axis of hyperbola $C$? [4 points]
